stem: Best guess: which title is appropriate for cash-basis financial statements?

choices.text: Statement of Assets and Liabilities Arising from Cash Transactions
choices.explanation: Correct. Special purpose statements use titles that don't suggest GAAP.

explanation: Special purpose statements use titles that don't suggest GAAP.

stem: Which special purpose framework report generally requires a restriction on use?

choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 800: reports on contractual-basis statements (and regulatory-basis ones not intended for general use) include an other-matter paragraph restricting use.
Only regulatory and contractual bases generally.

explanation: AU-C 800: reports on contractual-basis statements (and regulatory-basis ones not intended for general use) include an other-matter paragraph restricting use.

stem: Last year's statements were audited by a predecessor whose report isn't reissued. What does this year's report include?

choices.text: An other-matter paragraph on the predecessor's audit
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph states the prior period was audited by a predecessor, the date and type of opinion, and reasons for any modification.

choices.text: Nothing about the prior year, since it wasn't audited by us
choices.explanation: The prior-year audit must be described.

choices.text: An opinion on both years' financial statements
choices.explanation: The auditor didn't audit the prior year.

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph on the prior year
choices.explanation: The matter isn't in the statements.

explanation: AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph states the prior period was audited by a predecessor, the date and type of opinion, and reasons for any modification.

stem: Which basis is a special purpose framework?

choices.text: IFRS as issued by the IASB

choices.explanation: Correct. Special purpose frameworks: cash, tax, regulatory, contractual, and other bases.

explanation: Special purpose frameworks: cash, tax, regulatory, contractual, and other bases.

stem: In an audit of tax-basis statements, which paragraph is required?

choices.text: An emphasis-of-matter paragraph on the basis of accounting
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 800 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph describing the framework.

choices.text: A going concern section describing the entity's financial condition
An adverse opinion because the statements aren't GAAP
A paragraph restricting use of the report to the IRS

explanation: AU-C 800 requires an emphasis-of-matter paragraph describing the framework.

stem: An auditor is engaged to audit only the rental revenue of a retail tenant for a landlord. How is materiality determined?

choices.text: Based on the tenant's total financial statements

choices.explanation: The landlord's statements aren't the subject.
Materiality applies to element audits too.

choices.text: In relation to the rental revenue element
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 805: materiality is determined for the specific element being reported on.

explanation: AU-C 805: materiality is determined for the specific element being reported on.

stem: A lender asks the auditor to report on compliance with loan covenants. What assurance is provided?

choices.text: Negative assurance, given in connection with the audit
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 806: "nothing came to our attention that caused us to believe the Company failed to comply…" — only if the auditor audited the statements.

choices.text: Positive assurance of compliance with each covenant
No assurance, because covenants are legal matters
Reasonable assurance on internal control over compliance

explanation: AU-C 806: "nothing came to our attention that caused us to believe the Company failed to comply…" — only if the auditor audited the statements.

stem: The prior-year statements were reviewed, not audited. What does the current-year audit report include?

choices.text: An opinion on both years' financial statements
Nothing about the prior year, which was not audited
choices.explanation: The level of service must be described.

choices.text: An other-matter paragraph on the prior-year review
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph describes the prior-period service.

choices.text: A disclaimer of opinion on the current year
choices.explanation: The prior-year review is no basis for a disclaimer.

explanation: AU-C 700: an other-matter paragraph describes the prior-period service.

stem: This year, the auditor learns that last year's statements (on which it issued a qualified opinion) have been restated to correct the departure. What does the report include?

choices.text: The original qualified opinion on the prior year, unchanged
choices.explanation: The updated opinion should reflect the restatement.

choices.text: No mention of the prior year or the restatement
A disclaimer of opinion on the restated prior year
choices.explanation: There's no basis for a disclaimer.

choices.text: An updated unmodified prior-year opinion, other-matter paragraph
choices.explanation: Correct. When the updated opinion differs from the prior one, an other-matter paragraph discloses the date and type of the previous opinion, the reasons, and that the updated opinion differs.

explanation: When the updated opinion differs from the prior one, an other-matter paragraph discloses the date and type of the previous opinion, the reasons, and that the updated opinion differs.

stem: A comfort letter is addressed to whom?

choices.text: The general public and the investors
The underwriters and the client entity
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 920: letters for underwriters are addressed to the underwriters and the entity.

choices.text: The SEC's Division of Corporation Finance
The shareholders of the client entity

explanation: AU-C 920: letters for underwriters are addressed to the underwriters and the entity.

stem: Which statement title is appropriate for regulatory-basis statements of an insurance company?

choices.text: Balance Sheet: Generally Accepted Accounting Principles
Statement of Admitted Assets, Liabilities, and Surplus: Statutory
choices.explanation: Correct. Titles should reflect the framework and avoid implying GAAP.

choices.text: Consolidated Balance Sheet and Statement of Income
Income Statement and Statement of Changes in Equity

explanation: Titles should reflect the framework and avoid implying GAAP.

stem: A review of interim financial information under AU-C 930 is performed by whom and provides what?

choices.explanation: It's by the entity's annual auditor and gives limited assurance.

choices.text: The annual auditor; limited assurance via inquiry and analytics
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 930 applies when the auditor of the annual statements reviews interim information.

choices.text: The entity's internal auditors; no assurance given
The SEC staff; positive assurance on compliance

explanation: AU-C 930 applies when the auditor of the annual statements reviews interim information.

stem: An auditor reports on statements prepared on the cash basis. Which wording belongs in the opinion?

choices.text: "…in accordance with accounting principles generally accepted in the United States of America"
choices.explanation: The statements aren't prepared under GAAP.

choices.text: "…in accordance with the cash basis of accounting described in Note 1"
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 800: the opinion refers to the applicable special purpose framework.

choices.text: "…in accordance with the income tax basis"

explanation: AU-C 800: the opinion refers to the applicable special purpose framework.

stem: An auditor reports on a single schedule of rental income. How is materiality set?

choices.text: In relation to the full statements
choices.explanation: The engagement covers only the element.

choices.text: In relation to the schedule itself
choices.explanation: Correct. Materiality for an element audit relates to that element.

explanation: AU-C 805: in auditing a single element, materiality is determined for that element.

stem: A report on statements prepared on a regulatory basis intended only for the regulator includes:

choices.explanation: Unless the statements are for general use, no GAAP opinion is required.
Correct. Use is restricted when not for general use.

explanation: AU-C 800: regulatory-basis statements not intended for general use carry a restriction-on-use paragraph.

stem: A lender asks for a report on a borrower's compliance with loan covenants in connection with the audit. What form does the report take?

choices.explanation: Correct. It states nothing came to the auditor's attention indicating noncompliance.

choices.text: A full audit opinion on compliance
choices.explanation: That would be a separate engagement.

choices.text: A review conclusion on the statements

explanation: AU-C 806: a report on compliance with contractual or regulatory requirements in connection with an audit gives negative assurance.

stem: When may an auditor report on summary financial statements?

choices.text: Whenever the client requests a report
choices.explanation: The auditor must have audited the full statements.

choices.text: When it audited the full statements
choices.explanation: Correct. AU-C 810 requires the auditor to have audited the source statements.

choices.text: After only a review of the full statements

explanation: AU-C 810: the auditor may report on summary statements derived from statements it audited.

stem: Which procedures are performed in a review of interim financial information under AU-C 930?

choices.explanation: Controls aren't tested in a review.
Correct. A review doesn't include tests of details.

explanation: AU-C 930: an interim review consists mainly of analytical procedures and inquiries.

stem: Which title fits a statement prepared on the income tax basis?

choices.text: Statement of revenues and expenses (tax basis)
choices.explanation: Correct. Titles avoid GAAP terms like 'income statement'.

explanation: Special purpose framework statements use titles distinguishing them from GAAP statements.

stem: What is the earliest date for a report on summary financial statements?

choices.explanation: Correct. Or later, when evidence is obtained.

explanation: AU-C 810: the report on summary statements is dated no earlier than the report on the audited statements.

stem: The auditor issued an adverse opinion on the complete statements. May it give an unmodified opinion on accounts receivable, which is a major portion of them?

choices.explanation: Correct. It would contradict the adverse opinion.

explanation: AU-C 805: after an adverse opinion or disclaimer on the complete statements, an unmodified opinion on an element that is a major portion is inappropriate.

stem: Cash-basis statements are presented. What must the notes include?

choices.text: A description of the cash basis
choices.explanation: Correct. Including how it differs from GAAP.
The opinion isn't in the notes.

explanation: Statements under a special purpose framework describe the framework and its significant differences from GAAP.

stem: In a comfort letter to underwriters, what does the auditor give on changes after the latest audited statements?
explanation: AU-C 920: comfort letters may give negative assurance on subsequent changes in specified items.

stem: Tax-basis statements omit a description of how the basis differs from GAAP. What should the auditor consider?

choices.explanation: Correct. An inadequate description is a misstatement.

explanation: The auditor evaluates whether special purpose framework statements adequately describe the framework.
